description_en: Retrieves the current task list of a cloud phone instance
description_zh: 获取云手机实例当前任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone list-tasks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id t-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --task-status Finished --task-type Shell --instance-id cp-acfmxazb4p000 --next-token 55C15B1C-D507-45F0-B490-69D6E0F113C6 --max-results 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTasks

parameters.help_en: The list of task IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
- Finished: The task is completed.
- Processing: The task is running.
- Failed: The task has failed.

Default value: none.

> Only tasks in the Finished, Processing, or Failed state can be queried. Other values do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值范围：
- Finished：已完成。
- Processing：运行中。
- Failed：失败。

默认值：无。

> 只支持查询状态为Finished、Processing和Failed的任务，填入其他取值将不会生效
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en:
The name of the API operation for the task. Valid values:
- Shell: runs a shell command.
- InstallApplication: installs an application.
- UninstallApplication: uninstalls an application.
- SendFile: uploads a file.
- ImportImage: imports an image
parameters.help_zh:
任务操作的接口名称。取值范围：
- Shell：运行shell命令。
- InstallApplication：安装应用。
- UninstallApplication：卸载应用。
- SendFile：上传文件。
- ImportImage：导入镜像
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用无需配置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
返回的最大数。取值范围：1~100
默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results
